config_set_lines: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.0.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 10.0.2.1/24
set security zones security-zone trust interfaces ge-0/0/0.0
set security zones security-zone untrust interfaces ge-0/0/1.0
set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy zp-allow match source-address any
set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy zp-allow match destination-address any
set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy zp-allow match application any
set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy zp-allow then permit
set security policies global policy g-deny match from-zone trust
set security policies global policy g-deny match to-zone untrust
set security policies global policy g-deny match source-address any
set security policies global policy g-deny match destination-address any
set security policies global policy g-deny match application any
set security policies global policy g-deny then deny
